metadata.title: Winter Formal Portrait with Geometric Overlay

retrievalProfile.description: A formal male portrait in a black suit against a light architectural background, featuring heavy snow bokeh and large-scale, thin-stroke geometric typography.
triggerTerms: man in black suit holding gift

recipe.visualDefinition: A man in a black suit stands in profile against a light-colored stone pillar, holding a red gift box behind his back. The scene is overlaid with a dense layer of white snow bokeh and large, ultra-thin red geometric lettering that spans the width of the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between the black suit and the white architectural background
Text-to-subject overlap where typography sits in front of the figure
Color coordination between the red gift box and the red typography
Atmospheric depth created by varying sizes of snow bokeh particles
coreInvariants: Ultra-thin stroke weight for primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned right of center, full height from waist up, leaning slightly forward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red gift box held behind the back serves as a central color anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the subject's gaze from right to left, then down to the gift, and across the horizontal span of the typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space on the left side, occupied by the primary display text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White and light grey (background and snow)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value background with high saturation red accents and low value black subject.

letterConstructionRules: Extended horizontal proportions for secondary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'b' with a perfectly round bowl
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight and width contrast within the same geometric family.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric structure and hairline weight.
Classic geometric proportions suitable for the lowercase aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a man in a black suit in profile, standing against a white stone pillar. Add a dense overlay of white circular snow bokeh of varying sizes. He is holding a small red gift box with a black ribbon behind his back.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large-scale lowercase text in a hairline geometric sans-serif font. The primary text should be red and positioned on the left, overlapping the subject. Add a secondary line of text in a slightly heavier, wider red font at the bottom right.

verificationChecks: Is the typography ultra-thin and red?
Is there a visible snow bokeh effect?
Is the subject in a black suit against a light background?
Does the text overlap the subject?

postGenerationChecks: Check that text is legible despite the thin stroke.
Ensure snow bokeh does not obscure the subject's face.
Verify the red of the text matches the red of the gift box.
Confirm the geometric 'o' shapes are perfectly circular.
recipe.reuseFormula: Formal Portrait + Geometric Hairline Type + Snow Bokeh Overlay
